messages:
Maya: FYI opened PR #5824 to merge 'err-ref: rate limit + timeouts' into docs site. Short summary: consolidate 429 playbook, add Node & Go SDK snippet for Retry-After and context trim, fix two dead links in embeddings page. https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5824 :eyes:
Jordan: Nice. Can you paste the exact snippet you want for Node? I can adapt it for Go.
Maya: Sure — for Node we want something tiny showing exponential backoff + respect Retry-After:
Maya: ```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await retry(async () => {
  await client.generate(...);
}, {backoff: 'exponential', respectRetryAfter: true});
```
Prashant: Question: should we use the new unified retry header or the old X-Retry? Use unified: `Retry-After` only. I'll patch Go if you confirm.
Eli: I'll add a short 'context trim' example to the migration guide. Proposed one-liner: "If response tokens exceed model window, trim earlier messages or use prefix-only caching." I'll push a commit to PR.
Jordan: Also spotted a broken /docs/embeddings/#limits link — replaced with /docs/embeddings/limits in my branch. Maya can you confirm link target?
Maya: Confirmed — update to /docs/embeddings/limits is correct. Also add a small note about Dedicated customers and SLAs.
docs-ci: Build 5824 started — lint OK, broken-link check failed for one path: /integrations/old-sdk -> needs redirect.
Maya: Good catch. I've added a 301 redirect file in the PR.
Prashant: I'll do a quick review tonight and add Go snippet:
Prashant: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
err = redwood.Retry(func(){
  _, err = client.Generate(ctx, req)
}, redwood.RetryConfig{Backoff: redwood.Exponential, RespectRetryAfter: true})
```
Jordan: LGTM — small nit: docs style prefers present-tense short sentences. I'll land after CI passes :shipit: 
Maya: Thanks all! if anyone has a test snippet for streaming behavior + fallback (e.g., fall back to smaller model on 429) drop it here, otherwise I'll add a tiny note.
Eli: I'll add a one-line fallback example in the runbook tonight.
Maya: tagging @prashant @jordan @eli — please ack when merged.
